data.claim: Daraxonrasib nearly doubled survival against chemotherapy in previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer (RASolute 302), hazard ratio 0.40.
data.notes: Filed from the horse ranking build spec (9 Oct 2026). The claim is the spec's short form; check it against the source before it carries a score of 3. Source check, Paperclip run 9 Oct 2026: CONFIRMED from a peer-reviewed review (PMC13453085, J Hematol Oncol, Aug 2026), not the primary paper. HR 0.40 holds in both the RAS G12 group (13.2 vs 6.6 months) and the overall population (13.2 vs 6.7). The figures are secondary-sourced, so tier A is not yet earned on this record alone; Thomas to decide the tier.

horse_rubric.name: Mechanism
horse_rubric.question: Is the mechanism, or its class, validated in patients?

anchors.0: No human evidence for the mechanism
anchors.1: Preclinical rationale or a single uncontrolled signal
anchors.2: Consistent human activity in the class
anchors.3: Class validated by a randomised trial or a regulatory approval

horse_rubric.name: Exposure
horse_rubric.question: Has the asset shown the activity and exposure it needs outside China, at the dose that will be registered?

anchors.1: China-only data, or the registration dose not settled
anchors.2: Early ex-China data pointing the same way
anchors.3: Ex-China data consistent with China at the chosen dose

horse_rubric.name: Comparator
horse_rubric.question: Will it beat the standard of care that will exist when it launches?

anchors.0: Likely inferior to the coming standard
anchors.1: Unclear against a newly raised bar
anchors.3: Clear advantage over the coming standard

horse_rubric.name: Population
horse_rubric.question: Will the trial population translate to Western patients (biomarker mix, prior therapy, ethnicity)?

horse_rubric.name: Design
horse_rubric.question: Is the global development design credible to the FDA (multiregional data, dose optimisation, comparator choice)?

anchors.1: China-led design with gaps the FDA has flagged
anchors.3: Design aligned with FDA guidance and under way

horse_rubric.name: Value gap
horse_rubric.question: How far below Western comparables is the asset priced?

anchors.0: No discount, or priced above comparables

horse_rubric.name: Leverage
horse_rubric.question: How much does your position (Hong Kong, clinical, Asia access) add to the outcome or the information edge?

horse_rubric.name: Access
horse_rubric.question: Is there a working route to the people who decide on this asset?
